analysis.summary: React 18.2.0 + react-dom 18.2.0 + @types/react 18.2.43 + @types/react-dom 18.2.17 are one major behind. The plan task lists a 12-file blast radius: 10 components in src/dashboard/components/ + App.jsx + main.jsx (verified count = 12). React 19's two breaking changes that matter here are the deprecation of defaultProps on function components and the unification of ref-as-prop (forwardRef becomes optional). The codebase has no defaultProps today (verified via grep — zero matches in src/), so the migration is mostly the ref-as-prop audit plus the version bump. Closes F-DEP-007.
analysis.details: Current implementation: package.json declares react ^18.2.0 and react-dom ^18.2.0 (single runtime per the issue body). All 12 files live under src/dashboard/. createRoot from react-dom/client is the React 18 entry, unchanged in 19. The plan task warns about defaultProps, ref-as-prop, and forwardRef. Verification per the issue body: `npm ls react react-dom` shows 19.x for both; `npm run test:run` passes; no defaultProps on function components remain. The build path goes through Vite + @vitejs/plugin-react, so this issue depends on #26 (Vite 8) and indirectly on #25 (Node 24) and on #16. After this lands, plugin-react must be a version that supports React 19; that constraint was already flagged in #26's analysis. Risk: ref-as-prop is opt-in and most existing forwardRef code still works in 19 with a deprecation warning; defaultProps removal is the only hard break and the grep shows no current usage.
